title: Device tree
description: Describes the hierarchy of devices in a device project (.fbsdev): the top-level device (a PLC) and its nested child devices.

children.title: Children
children.description: The child devices attached below the PLC.

defaultSnippets.label: Example child device
defaultSnippets.description: One GPIO child device in slot 0.

identification.title: Device identification
identification.description: Identifies the device description this device instance is based on.

defaultSnippets.label: Example device identification
defaultSnippets.description: Numeric type, id and version taken from the device description.

type.title: Type
type.description: Numeric device type from the device description.

id.title: Id
id.description: Device identifier from the device description.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version string of the referenced device description. Usually a dotted version, but for some fieldbus devices it is a revision expression or something else.

defaultSnippets.label: Example revision expression
defaultSnippets.description: A revision expression, as used by some fieldbus devices instead of a dotted version.

device.title: Device
device.description: A device or module in the tree.

slotIndex.title: Slot index
slotIndex.description: Zero-based index of the slot this device occupies in its parent. Present only for slot-based devices; omitted otherwise.

children.title: Children
children.description: Child devices and modules attached below this device.
